scope: 실물 사진을 입력한 모델링 참조 시트와 표면 원본

outputs.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: reference sheet for a Korean apartment's old mechanical electricity meter, to be modeled in Blender. Input image 1 is a real meter close-up: preserve its industrial construction, not its brand or serial number. Input image 2 shows how meters sit behind a painted cabinet with individual viewing apertures. Create a clean photographic modeling sheet of ONE compact single-phase induction electricity meter: front, left three-quarter, right side, and close-up of the lower horizontal aluminum disc and upper mechanical number drums, arranged in a simple 2 by 2 grid on light gray. Black phenolic backplate, slightly amber transparent rounded rectangular cover, silver upper nameplate, black mechanical number drums, a real horizontal thin silver rotor disc viewed edge-on in a narrow lower window, dark copper coils behind. Plain generic faceplate with only 'kWh' readable; no manufacturer, no clock markings, no radial dial or pointer. Approximate housing width 130 mm and height 180 mm. The same construction in all views, restrained age and dust, fine injection mold lines, realistic glass thickness. Flat neutral studio lighting, no dramatic shadows, no decoration, no collage of different products, no watermark.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: consistent modeling reference for a small Korean villa management desk. Input images 1 and 2 are real compact DVR front and three-quarter photographs; use their low black steel enclosure, restrained front fascia, USB port, power and disk LEDs, rear connections as structural reference. Create a photographic reference sheet showing ONE unbranded compact 4-channel analog DVR at front, rear and three-quarter angles, plus a plain wired USB mouse at top and side angles. DVR is 260 mm wide, 215 mm deep, 45 mm high, four small feet, pressed steel lid seam, modest side ventilation, rear four BNC inputs, monitor output and power. Mouse is 110 mm long with two buttons and scroll wheel. Nothing futuristic; no huge buttons or exaggerated vents. Materials used indoors for years, clean except subtle finger polish, not rusty or abandoned. No text except small labels 'POWER', 'REC', 'USB'. Light gray background, neutral product photography, all parts readable, no logos or watermark.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: tileable base-color texture for the thin stainless outer jacket of a Korean rooftop water storage tank. Input image 1 is the real tank installation reference: retain its smooth thin rolled-sheet metal, not the scene or reflected surroundings. Generate ONE square, edge-to-edge, orthographic material scan representing 80 by 80 centimeters of lightly aged satin stainless steel. Neutral medium-light gray, extremely fine uniform brushing, subtle tonal mottling and faint wipe traces only. Uniform diffuse illumination with all lighting and specular reflections removed so this can be a game albedo map. No raised pebbles, no hammered dimples, no concrete grain, no giant flakes, no rust, no scratches you could catch a nail on. No panel borders, seams, rivets, holes, labels, perspective or vignette. The entire image is flat metal at a consistent scale and both directions tile seamlessly. 2048 square intended game texture.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless diffuse base-color map for a compact Korean rental apartment kitchen's acrylic solid-surface countertop. Reference image is the real LX Hausys HIMACS material sample page. Use only the G004 White Quartz swatch, left half, sixth row, third column, as a material reference, not the whole page. Create one square 2048 by 2048 edge-to-edge scan showing about 60 by 60 centimeters of off-white acrylic solid surface with sparse very small pale gray and white mineral chips, about 0.5 to 2 millimeters across. The dominant color is warm off-white and the pattern is low contrast, much calmer than black-and-white granite. Perfectly smooth, finely sanded surface. Flat neutral diffuse lighting, no specular highlights or cast shadows baked into the image. Both edges seamlessly tile. No veins, large terrazzo, deep pits, grout, cracks, stains, letters, borders, perspective, gradient or vignette. No artificial glitter or black salt-and-pepper noise. This is a usable albedo texture, not a presentation of a countertop.

note: 제품 사진은 참고용으로만 보관하며 게임에 배포하지 않는다. 생성 이미지는 실측·스캔 자료가 아니다.
